title: Path parameters
description: On top of static matching, support :param and return captured path params.

files.description: Router that supports static paths and :param

functions.signature: def add_route(self, method: str, path: str, handler) -> None
functions.doc: Register a static or :param route. path may contain :name segments.

functions.signature: def find_route(self, method: str, path: str) -> tuple
functions.doc: Return (handler, params). params is str→str; on a miss, handler is None and params is {}.

notes: Static-route behavior must remain. Do not implement *wildcard. A length mismatch is a miss.
